description: Change of use from retail (Class E) to dwelling (Class C3), involving single storey rear extension.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Existing Location and Site Plan, ref: 5109-P-20, dated April 2026Existing Flood Plans, ref: 5109-P-21, dated April 2026Existing Sections, ref: 5109-P-26, dated April 2026Proposed Site Plan, ref: 5109-P-23, dated April 2026Proposed Floor Plans, ref: 5109-P-24, Rev C, dated April 2026Proposed Elevations, ref: 5109-P-24, dated April 2026Proposed Sections, ref: 5109-P-25, dated April 2026Existing / Proposed Roof Plan, ref: 5109-P-28, dated May 2026Planning Statement, Design and Access Statement and Highways StatementEnergy Statement dated May 2026, revision R3Highway Safety Impact AssessmentSUDs - Covering LetterSUDs - Existing OS Map and Site PlanSUDs - Existing OS Map and Site PlanSUDs - Metropolitan SUDS Planter System DatasheetSUDs - Proposed Site PlanSUDs - Sustainable Drainage System Suds Management PlanSUDs - Sustainable Drainage System PlanSUDs - Typical Section Through Permeable Paved Rear CourtyardSUDS - Pro FormaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application.Reason: To ensure a design which complies with Development Plan Policies.

Prior to occupation of the residential unit hereby approved, details of waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the occupiers of adjoining premises; protect the general environment; prevent any obstruction to pedestrian movement and to ensure that there are adequate facilities for the storage and recycling of recoverable materials.

Prior to occupation of the residential unit hereby approved, unless otherwise agreed cycle parking should be provided in compliance with the following criteria:o	Provision of a minimum of TWO long stay cycle parking spaceso	in an accessible location: the access routes to the stores should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bikes to enter the stores, should be step free, close to the entrance and involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store doors) which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2mo	 secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fobo	fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roofReason: The Council's Climate Action and Transport Policies seek to increase the use of active and sustainable transport modes. This means that access to bicycle parking should be easy and secure to remove potential barriers to cycling.

Prior to occupation of the residential unit hereby approved, the development shall achieve: a) full and detailed application for the Secured by Design award scheme shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and the Metropolitan Police North Sector Designing out Crime Office, demonstrating how the Secured by Design Certificate will be achieved for this schemeb) the development shall achieve a Certificate of Compliance to the relevant Secure by Design Guide(s) submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in conjunction with the Metropolitan Police.The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and thereafter shall be fully retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that the approved crime prevention and security measures are satisfactorily implemented and retained, in the interests of the safety and security of future occupiers and the prevention of crime and anti-social behaviour.

Prior to first occupation of the residential unit hereby approved, the means of site enclosure, inclusive of the rear private gardens, must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall be installed prior to occupation.Reason: In the interests of highway safety and maintaining adequate visual clearance and privacy.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in full accordance with the energy efficiency, carbon reduction and sustainability measures set out within the submitted Energy Statement (prepared by POPE Sustainable Building Services Consultation, dated May 2026, revision R3).Reason: In the interests of sustainable development, energy efficiency and reducing carbon emissions, and to mitigate the impacts of climate change.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in full accordance with the Sustainable Drainage System (SuDS) details (see condition 2) submitted. The approved drainage measures shall be fully implemented prior to the first occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and maintained in accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates appropriate sustainable drainage measures, manages surface water runoff appropriately and reduces the risk of surface water flooding, in the interests of sustainable development.

Prior to first occupation of the residential unit hereby approved, the proposed new windows and doors shown on the approved plans shall be implemented.Reason: In the interests of ensuring and protecting the amenities of future occupiers of the development.
